notice: Third-party parsed dictionary tables for personal study; not an official Académie release. Eight explicitly marked regular -er supplements use deterministic morphology, not ML predictions.

schema.person_codes: 1/2/3=person, s/p=singular/plural, m/f=gender; semicolon joins applicable codes
schema.values: Forms omit subject pronouns; semicolon separates alternatives. Reflexive clitics are included.
schema.empty_tables: Unavailable forms of defective verbs; never infer missing forms.
schema.scope: Active and requested reflexive voices; simple and compound indicative, subjunctive, conditional, imperative, and participles. Passive voice is outside this collection.
